purpose: Decision support and provenance only. A catalog entry never grants procurement, dependency, license, egress, or code-copy approval.

license_classes.standard: Open specification or interoperability standard; verify each implementation separately.
license_classes.permissive: Permissive open-source license. Retain notices and inspect exact files before adapting code.
license_classes.copyleft: Open-source license with reciprocal obligations. Owner and legal review may be required.
license_classes.source-available: Source is visible but use, hosting, redistribution, or competition may be restricted.
license_classes.commercial: Proprietary managed service or product; integrate through approved contracts and APIs.
license_classes.mixed: Repository contains multiple licenses or separately licensed enterprise areas. Review at file level.

reuse_modes.implement-standard: Implement the published standard or use an independently reviewed compatible library.
reuse_modes.inspect-and-adapt: Potential code reference after exact revision, license, maintenance, tests, and notices are reviewed.
reuse_modes.integrate-via-api: Use documented APIs or SDKs under the customer's approved account and data policy.
reuse_modes.reference-only: Use architecture and UX ideas only; do not copy source into generated scaffolds.
reuse_modes.owner-review: Stop for explicit owner and license review before selecting or adapting the component.
reuse_modes.maintenance-only: Existing use may be supported, but do not select for a new foundation without an explicit reason.
